subject: Residents Guide to City Council Procedures
overview: The committee approved the latest draft of the City Council newsletter for distribution after making minor textual edits. It also discussed creating a one-page guide to City Council procedures for residents and voted to authorize Councilor Tseng to prepare a draft for the next meeting.

items.title: Resolution to publish a City Council newsletter (24-354)
items.summary: Approved the draft newsletter for distribution following edits regarding meeting commemorations, listening sessions, and minor wording adjustments.

items.title: Resolution to create a residents guide to City Council's procedures and processes (24-370)
items.summary: The committee discussed format, content, and translation options for a one-page resident guide to council meetings and voted to authorize Councilor Tseng to draft it before the next committee meeting.
